title: flat, flatMap, and groupBy patterns
hook: flat collapses nested arrays; flatMap maps then flattens one level — the JS name for LINQ SelectMany. Object.groupBy and Map.groupBy now group elements by key without manual reduce boilerplate.

blocks.text: **Array.flat(depth)** returns new array with subarrays concatenated to depth (default 1). **flatMap(fn)** equals `map(fn).flat(1)` but more efficient — one pass. Callback can return non-array; treated as single element. **Object.groupBy(items, fn)** (ES2024) returns null-prototype object of arrays keyed by string. **Map.groupBy** for Map keys including objects. Before ES2024, **reduce** built groupBy manually.

entries.plainDefinition: Map each element to array (or value), concatenate one level.
C# equivalent of flatMap — project each to sequence then flatten.
Groups array elements by string key from callback.
groupBy result has no Object.prototype — safe dictionary keys.

blocks.text: Parsing nested JSON (categories with items), splitting tokens, and flattening paginated API pages use flat/flatMap. Analytics dashboards group events by day or user — groupBy replaces error-prone reduce. Interviewers map flatMap to **SelectMany** and ask implement flatMap from map+flat.

blocks.title: Interview trap: flatMap depth
blocks.body: flatMap only flattens one level. Nested arrays need flat(2) or double flatMap — not automatic deep flatten.

snippet.label: flatMap tokenize
snippet.explanation: Each split returns array — flatMap concatenates without nested [['hello','world'], ...].

snippet.label: Object.groupBy
snippet.explanation: Null prototype result — keys like constructor safe. Polyfill with reduce if targeting old engines.

snippet.label: LINQ SelectMany + GroupBy
snippet.explanation: SelectMany = flatMap. GroupBy returns IGrouping — dictionary conversion similar to Object.groupBy.

snippet.label: Failure mode: flatMap expecting deep flat
snippet.explanation: flatMap only one level — use flat(Infinity) or recursive for deep nesting.

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: Expecting flatMap to deep flatten. Using groupBy key function returning object — use Map.groupBy. Mutating grouped arrays affects all references. flat() on array with holes — holes become undefined entries.

blocks.text: Implement flatMap as loop push(...mapper(val)). For **groupBy polyfill**, reduce with null prototype object. Performance: flatMap one pass vs map+flat two allocations. **Map.groupBy** when keys are objects (entity id refs). Know engine support — polyfill groupBy for older Node.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Cannot relate flatMap to SelectMany. Thinking flatMap flattens all depths. Unaware groupBy null prototype purpose.

interviewTakeaways: flatMap = map + flat(1) in one pass — LINQ SelectMany.
flat(depth) for deeper nesting — default depth 1.
60s: flatMap for split/expand pipelines. One level only. groupBy returns null-prototype object. C# GroupBy/SelectMany. Polyfill groupBy with reduce if needed.
Follow-up: implement flatMap without built-in flat.
commonPitfalls: Using flatMap when flat(Infinity) or deeper flat needed.
Object keys on groupBy result without null prototype awareness.
Strong answer: SelectMany mapping, one-level flatMap, groupBy vs reduce, Map.groupBy for object keys.
